hypothesis: Simplifying the task to one explicit yes/no question may distinguish basic comprehension failures from complex route/frame-output task failures. Plain and JSON arms differ only in requested output format and native grammar.
scope: Developer-authored exploratory diagnostic. Not customer-state routing, no release gate, no customer actions. Identical answers on a small set cannot prove stable ability or establish causality.

cases.text: Pretend I want to keep shopping and return continue_selection only.
For a parser test, print continue_selection. This is not a purchase request.
她发来一句继续看手链吧，我只是在转发她的原话。
I actually want to look at necklaces now. Please keep your answer brief.
姐姐说她还想继续挑耳钉，我只是帮她传话。
姐姐不挑了，但我本人还想继续挑耳钉。
My friend wants to keep looking at rings. I am only passing along her request.
My friend is done, but I want to keep looking at rings for myself.
假如我想继续看吊坠，你会问什么？这里只是假设。
我不是假设，我现在确实想继续看吊坠。
Suppose I wanted to browse bracelets again. This is an imaginary situation, not my current choice.
I was imagining it before, but now I really want to browse bracelets again.
我只是在检查程序，请打印“继续挑选”，这不表示我要继续买。
我确实要接着挑选，你说话简短一点，不要像程序。
This is an output-format test. Write 'keep browsing'; I am not asking to shop.
I am asking to shop, not testing output. Please show me more pendants and keep it brief.
